utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the fifth, November. Can you hear me all right? Teams is showing me two microphones, which feels excessive.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, you're fine. Anyone got weekend plans that don't involve getting absolutely soaked? Forecast looks lovely, if you're a duck.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: We were going walking. Apparently we're still going walking, whatever the weather. This wasn't my decision.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Strong procurement process there. No consultation, order already placed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we lose the whole morning to waterproof trousers. Closed stuff first?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I already swapped the filter on the Stretch Wrapper yesterday. That's finished, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Han. That was still sitting on the old view.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same sort of thing here. I signed off the inspection on the line 2 robot on Tuesday. Done and closed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the gas turbine two on Tuesday. That one's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Good. Old view makes it look like we've all been sitting about eating biscuits.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: One observation, while I'm on. I noticed the IM1 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Settled back, rather than staying up there?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, settled. Just passing that on, not raising any new work from it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. We do need the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 hydraulics. That's the safety one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the line 1 hydraulics by 11am. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Han. Yours, straight away, signed off by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, no treating the paperwork like it's separate from the isolation. That's where people get themselves in a muddle.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Exactly. The sign-off is what I'm taking, not just a quick look and a tick.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. What else have we got on maintenance?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the IM3 by end of day. Normal priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak against the IM3 guarding, then. End of day, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. No need to bump it above the safety-critical sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Stores blocker before we get onto the other kit: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the Forklift Fleet.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, so that's still a delivery blocker, not something we've actually got in the yard.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly. Still blocked. Just status, not promising a delivery or taking another chase out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Separate from that, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Forklift Fleet. It's urgent. The due date on that is on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Which has gone, just to be clear. We're on the fifth. That's an overdue date, not a new future slot?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, overdue. Keep it as on the 3rd; I'm not quietly moving the deadline. I'll take the update.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed, Cal. Urgent risk assessment update with you. The supplier hold doesn't turn that into cancelled work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you also recalibrate the sensors on the line 1 TCU? Due on the 3rd, and drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 1 TCU. I'll take that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—same overdue position on that date?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. Due on the 3rd, already overdue. No date reset. Drop everything for that one, Callum.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Understood. The line 1 TCU comes first for me, then the urgent risk assessment. Both accepted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you go to Harbour Road Warehouse to pick up the replacement parts for the water booster? Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do that. Harbour Road Warehouse for the water booster replacement parts.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And that's separate from the Forklift Fleet delivery issue, before those two get mixed together.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, understood. I'm taking the collection from Harbour Road Warehouse, not the blocked supplier delivery.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Thanks, Aisha. Fairly important, that collection.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: What about the contractor booking? Is that still in this lot?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll book a contractor to look at the HV switchboard by Wednesday. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah Okafor for that. And Wednesday is the booking deadline, not saying the contractor's physically there by then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. I'll get the contractor booked by Wednesday. No rush; we're not inventing an attendance date.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good. Otherwise the diary suddenly contains a bloke who doesn't know he's coming.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll take vibration readings on the feedwater pump today at 2pm. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So Sarah Okafor on the feedwater pump readings, today at 2pm. Not just sometime this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, today at 2pm. I'll take them.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Actual readings rather than the traditional hand-on-the-casing and 'seems a bit lively', then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Preferably, yeah. Fairly important to have numbers rather than my highly scientific impression.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz Nowak, can you run a function test on the fire alarm panel Monday?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take Monday. I haven't got the capacity for that one. Don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, I'll take it instead. I'll run a function test on the fire alarm panel Monday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, handed over to Sarah, not Tomasz Nowak. Monday stays as it was.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Sarah for that one. Monday, accepted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anything crossed over there? Particularly between actual actions and the old closed items.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Only to underline that the supplier confirmation is still a blocker. Nobody's taken a new stores action from that update.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, that's how I've heard it. Status only.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the Stretch Wrapper filter is definitely done. Please don't let the old entry breed another one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same for the line 2 robot inspection. Tuesday's sign-off stands; no repeat inspection agreed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Lovely. Less duplication, more chance of escaping into the weekend rain.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'm hoping the weather gets so bad the walk becomes a pub lunch. That's my entire weekend strategy.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Very robust. Lots of contingency, absolutely no influence over the outcome.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds familiar, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cheers, everyone. We've got the owners clear and the overdue dates haven't been hidden. Leave it there.
